failure_policy: Preserve every planned dataset and unsuccessful fit. Failed or unattempted planned permutations remain unknown within B599; never condition the denominator on successful fits. Do not replace a source-run failure with a successful duplicate from another run.
execution_implementation: Use the HPC-validated direct normal-PDF objective with unchanged arithmetic/optimizer. This single-engine run recomputes nuisance for every new label permutation. No mixture reuse across schemes, datasets or permutations.
freeze_policy: Immutable source/config snapshot created before any42xxxxxx confirmation data are generated. Earlier41xxxxxx structural-preflight data are excluded. Changes prompted by confirmation outcomes require a new candidate and fresh seeds.
full_p_policy: Absolute seeds 42200000 through 42200009 complete the single target B599 budget. Sharing numerical seed values with e2/e4 cells is common-random-number coupling across different DGP cells, not duplicate data or additional independent R within a cell.
primary_endpoint: False rejection for the unique true-null e2/e4 local pair when e33 alone has an exact K27 alternative. R1000, alpha/3 local threshold, all planned outcomes and Monte Carlo uncertainty.
geometry_policy: Reference nuisance, sample_scale=1, uniform exact K27 relative alternatives; planned and realized inversions must agree.
family_policy: One target local error endpoint only. No family tag is attached, and no complete-family power or global-max result is claimed for this run.

replication_accounting.shared_seed_policy: Coupled across alternative-group cells; report each cell separately rather than pooling as independent repetitions.
